honestyStatement: This scorecard chooses a recommended first-revenue lane, but it does not authorize outreach, CRM edits, invoices, payments, publication or deployment.

lanes.why_this_rank: Closest to money because it does not require client PII, a live matched lead, or payment-provider approval. The lawyer registration and manual invoice follow-up path already exist.
lanes.existing_assets: lawyer registration billing fields; lawyer onboarding payment follow-up; manual invoice path; prospect outreach links; plan-payment admin path
lanes.next_owner_action: Approve one controlled lawyer outreach or choose one existing lawyer/prospect to offer a paid manual-invoice plan.
lanes.required_owner_inputs: lawyer/prospect target; plan or monthly price; billing contact; approved message wording
lanes.proof_needed_before_revenue_claim: manual invoice reference can mark invoice_sent; private payment evidence is required before paid revenue
lanes.main_blocker: No owner-selected lawyer/prospect and no approved outreach/action.

lanes.why_this_rank: Strong revenue fit and already has Bituach Leumi prospect/readiness packets, but it needs verified specialists plus a consented lead and owner release before billing.
lanes.existing_assets: BTL revenue hints; held lead triage; first paid lead preflight; controlled test drill; prospect activation packet; manual terms packet
lanes.next_owner_action: Approve verifying one Bituach Leumi specialist and exact lead-fee terms, or provide a consented controlled lead for a no-PII drill.
lanes.required_owner_inputs: selected specialist; fee; billing contact; client permission if a real lead is used
lanes.proof_needed_before_revenue_claim: accepted partner terms, owner release, invoice reference and private payment evidence
lanes.main_blocker: Requires live CRM/admin evidence and consented lead handling; higher privacy and routing risk than subscription.

lanes.why_this_rank: Commercially interesting but less ready because partner type, accepted terms, jurisdiction fit and first demand source are not as narrow as the subscription or BTL lanes.
lanes.existing_assets: UK WhatsApp supplier handoff packet; supplier/partner terms patterns; manual invoice proof rules
lanes.next_owner_action: Choose one supplier category and one real supplier candidate, then approve terms-only verification.
lanes.required_owner_inputs: supplier category; partner target; fee; jurisdiction scope; billing contact
lanes.proof_needed_before_revenue_claim: accepted supplier terms, owner release, invoice reference and private payment evidence
lanes.main_blocker: Too broad without a selected supplier category and partner.

lanes.why_this_rank: Useful for future inbound conversion, but it does not create money until owner approves route QA, merge, uPress deployment and a measured conversion path.
lanes.existing_assets: homepage human-help implementation; static visual QA; owner deployment approval packet
lanes.next_owner_action: Approve real WordPress route QA only; do not merge or uPress until route QA passes.
lanes.required_owner_inputs: route QA approval; later merge/uPress approval
lanes.main_blocker: Owner has not approved live/staging route QA or deployment.

ownerRows.decision_needed: Select exactly one first-revenue lane for the next live-approved action.
Approve whether Codex may prepare a live/admin action checklist for the selected lane, still without sending/contacting/publishing.
If the lane is lawyer subscription, name the target or allow a generic one-target outreach draft only.
